from pathlib import Path
import cProfile,hashlib,json,os,pstats,subprocess,time
import numpy as np
from tests.unit.test_sm120_scheduled_activation import _frontend_program
from tessera.compiler.nvidia_tensor_lhs import package_traced_lhs
from tessera.compiler.prepared_nvidia_lhs import PreparedLhsCall
from tessera import runtime as rt
assert rt._nvidia_device_name()=="sm_120"
_,values,public=_frontend_program(np.float16,(129,256,33))
graph,_=public._trace_frontend_capture(values,{})
program=package_traced_lhs(graph,activation_schedule="flat_128")
owner=PreparedLhsCall(program)
a,b=values;wide=a.astype(np.float32)
normalized=(wide/np.sqrt(np.mean(wide*wide,axis=-1,keepdims=True)+np.float32(1e-5))).astype(np.float16)
expected=np.maximum(0,normalized).astype(np.float32) @ b.astype(np.float32)
try:
 for _ in range(25):owner(values)
 output,_=owner(values)
 np.testing.assert_allclose(output,expected,atol=.003,rtol=.003)
 before=owner.scratch_stats()
 old_run,old_popen=subprocess.run,subprocess.Popen
 def forbidden(*args,**kwargs):raise AssertionError("warm prepared call attempted subprocess/compilation")
 subprocess.run=forbidden;subprocess.Popen=forbidden
 profiler=cProfile.Profile()
 try:
  start=time.perf_counter();profiler.enable()
  for _ in range(200):output,_=owner(values)
  profiler.disable();wall=time.perf_counter()-start
 finally:
  subprocess.run=old_run;subprocess.Popen=old_popen
 np.testing.assert_allclose(output,expected,atol=.003,rtol=.003)
 assert owner.scratch_stats()==before
 rows=[]
 for (filename,line,function),(primitive,total,self_seconds,cumulative,callers) in pstats.Stats(profiler).stats.items():
  if "tessera/" in filename:
   rows.append({"file":filename,"line":line,"function":function,"primitive_calls":primitive,"calls":total,"self_seconds":self_seconds,"cumulative_seconds":cumulative})
 rows.sort(key=lambda r:r["cumulative_seconds"],reverse=True)
 packet={"scope":"instrumented warm prepared call attribution, not latency or throughput comparison","storage":"f16","shape_mkn":[129,256,33],"calls":200,"instrumented_wall_seconds":wall,"max_abs_error":float(np.max(np.abs(output-expected))),"subprocess_reentry":"forbidden; all warm calls completed","native_scratch_stats_before_after":list(before),"rows":rows[:30],"source_sha256":{p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ("python/tessera/compiler/prepared_nvidia_lhs.py","python/tessera/compiler/prepared_nvidia_matmul.py","python/tessera/compiler/nvidia_tensor_lhs.py","python/tessera/compiler/nvidia_native.py")},"provider_sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(os.environ["TESSERA_NVIDIA_PTX_LAUNCH_LIB"]).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"script_source":Path(__file__).read_text()}
 Path("/home/angstorms/scratch/sm120-relu-coalescing-20261014/host-attribution.json").write_text(json.dumps(packet,indent=2)+"\n")
 for row in rows[:10]:print(row["function"],row["calls"],round(row["self_seconds"]*1000,3),round(row["cumulative_seconds"]*1000,3),flush=True)
finally:owner.close()
